free_tier.stated: Free is $0 with 100 awake vCPU-hours a month, 5 GB of storage, 3 boxes at once of up to 2 vCPU, sessions of up to 4 hours, an egress allowlist you control and one workspace that sleeps after 30 minutes idle. One Free account per person.
free_tier.notes: The unit as published is an awake vCPU-hour: one vCPU running for one hour while the box is awake; paused and idle time between tool calls is free. No card is needed on Free, and included hours reset monthly. Each vCPU carries 4 GiB of memory at no extra charge.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a microVM with a total storage allowance, and no single-object size cap is published
per_object_cap.notes: The Free allowance is 5 GB total storage across disks, snapshots, templates and objects; storage above the allowance is not available on Free.

retention.stated: A sandbox keeps its files until stopped; pausing keeps memory and files and resuming restores them. A Free workspace sleeps after 30 minutes idle. The plans reference states 5 GB of included storage on Free; no separate day count for automatic deletion is published.
retention.notes: Sandbox files survive stops and pauses; snapshots use the storage allowance. Unverified: any automatic retention window for snapshots or stopped boxes.

egress.terms: On Free, network access is by an egress allowlist the customer controls: 'A sandbox can reach only what your organization's egress allowlist allows.' Pro and up can choose open access or an allowlist. Ports are reached through an authenticated tunnel only; there are no public URLs. No per-GB egress price is published.

interface_detail: A REST API at api.sandscale.dev with a personal API key, a sandscale CLI, TypeScript and Python SDKs, a remote MCP server at https://mcp.sandscale.dev/mcp, and SSH into a box with a short-lived certificate. Object storage is S3-compatible with an S3 endpoint and access keys.
tooling: npm i @sandscale/sdk or pip install sandscale for the SDKs; the sandscale CLI, the hosted MCP server at https://mcp.sandscale.dev/mcp, SSH with a short-lived certificate, and standard S3 tools for object storage.
chaining: Firecracker microVMs for agent code with paused/idle time free, Vault for secrets and S3-compatible storage, so short agent runs bill only for awake vCPU-hours and can keep artifacts after the box stops.

limits.value: 100 awake vCPU-hours a month on Free; paid overage not available on Free, so new boxes wait until next month
API endpoints are rate limited with HTTP 429 and Retry-After on rate_limited; MCP allows 120 calls a minute per app and 60 a minute per person
Free sessions last up to 4 hours; one workspace sleeps after 30 minutes idle; 3 boxes at once, up to 2 vCPU each
the Free egress allowlist is customer-controlled, and changing a policy or widening a network reach may require confirmation with a passkey, authenticator app or emailed code

limits_note: Plans set boxes at once, vCPU per box, build-host lease hours, storage and monthly vCPU-hours; a request that would exceed a quota is refused before anything starts with quota_exceeded (402 or 429). Memory above 4 GiB per vCPU counts as extra vCPU-hours: every 4 GiB-hours of extra memory is 1 vCPU-hour.
binding_note: The 100 awake vCPU-hours a month is the first constraint on Free: it is metered only while a box is awake, and when it is used up, new boxes wait until the next month because overage is not available on Free. The 3-box concurrency and 4-hour session cap are smaller but secondary.

identity_cost.detail: The signup form at cloud.sandscale.dev asks for Full name, Work email and Password, and requires acceptance of the terms. The page states: 'Verify your email address before you start sandboxes and workspaces. Unverified accounts are removed after 7 days.' One Free account per person; accounts linked by the same card, device or GitHub account share one Free allowance. No card is needed for Free; Pro and up need a payment method. Passkeys and multi-factor sign-in are available on every plan; no phone number or ID document is named.

reliability_note: Quota overruns are refused before a box starts with quota_exceeded; MCP tool calls are capped at 120 a minute per app and 60 a minute per person. A 402 payment_required stops new spend on paid plans while reads keep working. Unverified accounts are removed after 7 days.
confidence_note: The vendor's own plans reference, FAQ, concepts, API limits, security and quickstart pages and the console signup form were read on 2026-11-24. The live signup and verification steps are known only from the published form text.

Self-hosted and bring-your-own-cloud deployments exist only on Enterprise and are not the offer priced here.
